name: temml
description: TeX to MathML conversion in JavaScript.

scripts.test: pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm unit-test
scripts.minify: terser dist/temml.js -o dist/temml.min.js -c -m && terser contrib/mhchem/mhchem.js -o contrib/mhchem/mhchem.min.js -c -m && terser contrib/copy-tex/copy-tex.js -o contrib/copy-tex/copy-tex.min.js -c -m
scripts.build: rollup --config ./utils/rollupConfig.mjs && node utils/insertPlugins.js && node utils/copyfiles.js && pnpm minify
